descriptions.d10b_rebuild_layout_802b3d04: When either observed layout dimension changes, store both values and, only when readiness equals one, drain the child queue with captured table/object item-zero and remove calls. Release and clear six held interfaces in order, clear readiness, then invoke build and apply layout callbacks. Preserve null checks, live reloads, full-width dimensions and ready equality. Native inline handle reset accounts for constant lifetimes. Partial inferred owner/interface views; full classes and ignored callback return types unknown. No owned initialized data.
